粘贴静态原词或打开文本。开始打轴后，在 Apple Music 播放这首歌。: Paste untimed lyrics or open a text file. Play this song in Apple Music when you start timing.
空行会跳过。间奏可在打轴时单独标记。: Blank lines are skipped. Mark any instrumental gap while timing.
当前打轴尚未保存。要关闭编辑器吗？: Your timing is unsaved. Close the editor?
播放时可预览，选中左侧歌词可微调起止时间。: Preview during playback, or select a line to adjust its start and end.
听到这句开唱时按 Enter。: Press Enter when this line starts.
这句唱完时按 Enter。后面有一段器乐时按 G，等下一句开唱再按 Enter。: Press Enter when the line ends. For an instrumental gap, press G instead and press Enter when the next line starts.
确认后将以手动动态歌词保存。: Save to use this timing as your manual lyrics.
Backspace 撤销上一次标记或调整。: Backspace undoes the last mark or edit.
所选歌曲的原词已变化，请从歌曲列表重新打开打轴。: The original lyrics changed. Reopen the timing editor from the song list.
请选择缺少动态原词的歌曲来打轴。: Select a song without timed lyrics.
请在 Apple Music 播放这首歌。: Play this song in Apple Music.
播放会话已变化。请撤销标记后重新开始打轴。: Playback session changed. Undo your marks before starting again.
正在等待可用的播放位置。: Waiting for a usable playback position.
打轴原词超过 128 KB。: Lyrics exceed the 128 KB timing editor limit.
所有歌词已经标记，可以校对并保存。: All lines are marked and ready to review and save.
请先标记这一句开始唱的时间。: Mark the start of this line first.
下一句须晚于上一句的结束时间。: The next line must start after the previous line ends.
结束时间须晚于开始时间。可以撤销后重标。: The end must follow the start. Undo to mark it again.
请保持每句起止时间正确，且相邻歌词不重叠。: Each end must follow its start. Adjacent lines must stay in order without overlap.
请标记所有歌词的起止时间后再保存。: Mark the start and end of every line before saving.
原词包含 LRC 控制标签，请移除标签后重试。: Remove LRC control tags from the lyrics and try again.
